race.description: 2026 Qbred Triad Final - 4yo Entires & Geldings Pace (G2)
race.comment: FRENCH FRIES (11) is looking for black-type success after suffering a defeat last time out a much weaker race over 2138m at this track, arriving 2 metres behind the winner. Top-shelf performer who is perfectly placed to win. BRAVENTREACHEROUS (12) comes here fresh from success a week ago over 2138m at this track, scoring by 2 metres. Up in class but hard to beat again. OHOKA DREAM (6) won a much weaker race over 1660m at this track last time out to bring up his hat-trick, scoring by 11 metres. Sure to prove hard to beat. FIRE RAISER (7) was an impressive winner last start over 2280m at Redcliffe, getting home by a neck. Looms as a serious challenger.
